title: Quiz: Modules and Imports
description: Check your understanding of Modules and Imports.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in C++?
questions.explanation: In C++, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does an import statement do?
options: Makes functions/code from another module available
questions.correctAnswer: Makes functions/code from another module available
questions.explanation: Imports load reusable code into your program.

questions.question: True or False: Every program must import at least one module to run.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: $import / use / include math   // bring in the math module
In C++, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
